verdict.rationale: Notte's docs and GitHub strongly market natural-language task execution ('Give AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites', 'Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt. No selectors, no maintenance'), and this is corroborated by CLI/MCP integrations letting agents issue NL commands. However, a hands-on community report describes a concrete failure ('just tried to use it to extract data from hyatt.com completely failed... doesn't work'), directly contradicting the claimed reliability of natural-language operation. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that NL commands reliably work across sites, and no rebuttal to the hyatz.com failure.
